title: Second-Meal Buyers and the Departed-Balance Cover: School Nutrition Services Meal Account Schedule
content:
A departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts a second meal by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the cover date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the second-meal price is added to every serving day counted; one to three purchases add once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase adds nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the cover date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the cover date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

| Times a second meal was rung up in the month before the cover date | What is added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the second-meal price (4.25) for every serving day counted |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |

## Both sides of the regular-buyer line (hypothetical)

- Four purchases in the month, with nine serving days in question: 4.25 for each of the nine days.
- Three purchases in the month: the three amounts actually paid, once, whatever the number of serving days.
